{"subject":"Cost and latency for multi-region fraud scoring","body":"Hi Maya, thanks for connecting.

Northwind Payments runs fraud scoring on Astra DB, and your team is now focused on evaluating cost and latency improvements for its multi-region data layer. With IBM having completed its acquisition of DataStax in May 2025, this could be a natural moment to review options.

ScyllaDB delivers higher throughput per node, which typically means fewer nodes and lower infrastructure cost for workloads like this.

Would it help if I sent a short comparison for a three-region setup at around 40k transactions per second?

Oz
GTM Engineer, ScyllaDB

Reply STOP to opt out.","evidence_ids":["s01","s02"],"value_prop_ids":["vp_tco"],"context_fact_ids":["cf_ibm"]}
